svg.text: StackChan hybrid brain: perception, internal state, learned policy, safe body
M5Stack CoreS3 / ESP32-S3 - one closed sensorimotor loop, 20 Hz brain tick (50 ms) - every neural module has a safe fallback
dashed = feedback / efference | numbers: params, MACs, measured time on the robot
3 channels: lum, compensated diff, raw diff
exact: brightness, light change, bright spot
touch 150 ms; shake held 2 s; tilt 1.5 s
time of day: night, day, dawn, dusk windows
+ dense 64 -> 13 outputs; 24 k params, 0.57 M MAC
sim + COCO + 13 real sessions of THIS camera
+ 28 real sessions of THIS robot's microphone
(claps recorded with a parked head; bang = clap|knock)
classes: silence speech clap sharp cont. low high tonal dir.
LIF neurons, 2 substeps x 25 ms per 50 ms tick, noise current in every
neuron: the core is never silent. INT8 weights: dense input projection
(258 x 768) and a sparse recurrent matrix (47 k synapses, event driven).
The slow drives (seconds to minutes) live in leaky readout cells; 25
readouts form the SNN state of the bus. Trained with surrogate gradients
on synthetic days and rollouts; teacher = designed drive dynamics.
Robot: ~7 ms per tick (input 4.6 ms, neurons + synapses 4.7 ms).
Associative memory - LEARNED ON THE ROBOT: 11 cue x 2 outcome plastic synapses,
three-factor rule -> expect petting / rough handling (2), kept in NVS
annoyance clamp (C++): anger needs touch / shake / loud evidence
100 inputs -> dense 64 -> GRU 64 -> dense 48 -> 51 outputs; ~37 k INT8 params
trained by imitation of a designed teacher, then DAgger rollouts in the digital twin
robot: ~3.5 ms/tick; invalid output -> rejected / clamped, neutral action
outputs: head, gaze, blink, WHICH FACE (21), face valence, sound intent
(pitch, glide, vibrato, length, syllables, 4 families), sing, invite, startle
head: yaw +-100, pitch -20..35 deg, no jump over 70 deg,
<= 8 servo packets/s, speed 12..110 deg/s scaled by stamina
primitives: singing sway, nod series, startle flinch, call to every bang, turns in a talk
voice: intent + face -> BabbleVoice, <= 6 calls/min (reserve for touch / bang)
song governor: windows only, <= 45 s, rest 4 min, hush by touch
face: the policy's choice of 21 (debounced), gaze, blink, person symbol
LEDs: breathing + heartbeat, brightness / wave = led_activity
watchdogs: servo stall (gyro) -> rail power cycle, task WDT, battery
Droid voice: BabbleNet + analogue droid synth (own audio task)
BabbleNet GRU 48 (31 k INT8) + the face's emotion: a phrase, note by note -
1 of 10 kinds (whistle chirp pip burble trill warble giggle squeal
growl coo), glide, ending flick, pitch, FM, harmonics, rate, stop.
Synth: analogue-style droid (sine + band-limited harmonics + FM), 24 kHz,
no speech model. Audio task on core 1 prio 5: never starved.
body feedback: real head velocity (gyro), servo state, battery, own voice
What changed relative to v2 (NeuroBrain, 6780 LIF neurons, one recurrent network)
one recurrent spiking net did vision, hearing, drives, motor and voice (6780 cells, ~210 k synapses, 10-12 ms/tick)
specialised modules around one FeatureBus: Vision NN, Auditory NN, 768-neuron SNN, GRU policy (also picks the face), droid voice
each part is small, testable, replaceable and retrainable on its own; the policy can later be refined by reward without touching perception
perception: simulator ground truth + COCO photos + ESC-50 / LibriSpeech + real recordings from this robot's microphone (parked head for claps) and camera; voice: teacher recipes per face
perception -> SNN state -> policy -> executor -> body -> feedback (gyro, efference, prediction error) -> perception
vision: no false persons in an empty room (threshold, new empty frames, retrain), claps while the head moves, SNN on real rollouts, reward refinement
